text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the "Summer Training Camp"
for improving skills begins!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone is here, yes? Listen up: you are mostly
free to do as you like. However, that does not mean there are no rules.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Especially causing trouble for the staff at the training camp is absolutely—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey, hey, hey, El!
Don't eat so many snacks right before a meal!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually, I ended up skipping breakfast~!
El's tummy is rumbling!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Agh, honestly, can't help it! Living on sweets
will wreck your nutrition. I've got rice balls, eat up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno~!
Thank you so much, Hishi Ama-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Honestly. ...And! Make sure to greet our neighbors around the training camp grounds in a loud, clear voice—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hey, Sky! Playing a 3D game
on a bus is gonna make ya carsick, so cut it out!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: C'mon, pretty please~. I'm just about to reel in the final boss, the sperm whale~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, did you take your motion sickness meds?
If not, here, drink this right now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Good grief, what a troublesome bunch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Everyone's as carefree as always...
I mean, Hishi Ama-san really is so sweet, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
As expected of the Miho dorm head.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Non-non!
Rather than a dorm leader, she's an 'Okan'!

All in all...
The intense summer training camp with Hishi Amazon has begun!
